items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-09-04
items.q: He had left the Creole band before the others, before Kepard and Big Guy, for instance, had taken his place after he left.

ctx.x: Yeah. For some reason, they called them bootleggers. It means that they were pirated. One of the labels is called Jolly Roger. And incidentally, Victor would press those things for those guys. They'd steal the Victor rights, you might say. They didn't steal anything directly because it wasn't the actual property. But they'd take the records off, copy them, and issue them on another record. And Victor was pressing their own material for other people, which they always refused to do if they knew it. But they never…
